checks.name: kepler-third-law (satellites)
checks.description: Catalogued orbital periods are compared with the period predicted by Kepler's third law, P = 2*pi*sqrt(a^3/GM_parent), using the parent GM published by NASA/NSSDC.

checks.name: radius-provenance
checks.description: Every body either carries a published radius or is explicitly flagged as lacking one, so the renderer and the information panel never present an invented size.

checks.name: planet-element-coverage
checks.description: The eight planets use the JPL/Standish Keplerian elements plus the Mode A ephemeris engine; both paths must be available.

warnings: No published diameter is available for eris, haumea, makemake; these bodies are rendered from their absolute magnitude and the UI reports 暂无可靠数据.
